summary: Exactly two of 125 controls fail on ZHANGWEI. Both build their fixture in tempfile.TemporaryDirectory (C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp) and then call acquire_r5.read_exact, which calls acquire_daily.require_allowed_read on the resolved path. acquire_daily.allowed_windows_path only accepts e:\blackbox\ and e:\blackbox_engines\, so the temp fixture is refused with EXTERNAL_LINK_TARGET before the intended assertion can run.
why_gpt_offline_saw_125_ok: OFFLINE_RECEIPT.json records python 3.12.14 (main, Aug 25 2026) [Clang 22.1.3], i.e. a non-Windows interpreter. require_allowed_read is a no-op when os.name != "nt" (require(os.name!="nt" or allowed_windows_path(...))). On such a host the temp fixture path is never checked, so both controls pass. The defect is therefore invisible offline and deterministically visible on the real Windows execution host.

failing_tests.intent: read_exact returns the exact 15489-byte body and leaves st_mtime_ns unchanged
failing_tests.blocked_by: require_allowed_read rejects the temp path resolved outside E:\\BLACKBOX

failing_tests.intent: a body with one extra byte must be refused as IDENTITY_DRIFT
failing_tests.blocked_by: same path guard fires first, so the expected reason string never occurs

proof_product_logic_is_sound.note: Read-only revalidation; the failed R4 body is unchanged and still matches its pin. The 123 passing controls include every quarantine/gate/quota/reuse control that constrains R5 behaviour.

repair_owner: GPT (package author). The native executor may not patch package code, relax allowed_windows_path, skip tests, switch interpreter or change rules to force a pass.
suggested_repair_options_for_review: Build the fixture inside an allowed root, e.g. a TemporaryDirectory(dir=root) under E:\\BLACKBOX, so the path guard is exercised on a permitted path.
Or raise the two fixtures through a documented allowed-root seam instead of the system temp directory.
Or, if the intent is genuinely path-independent, have the control assert on a path already inside the allowed roots.
do_not_do: rerun to get a different result
